hub.name: C2P Hub
hub.location: Ground Floor, Department of Computer Engineering Building, ABU Zaria
hub.tagline: From concept to product, built by students.
hub.mission: C2P Hub exists to help Computer Engineering students turn coursework ideas into working prototypes - through mentorship, lab access, and a peer community that ships.

programs.title: AI & Data Science Track
programs.description: A guided track covering Python, machine learning fundamentals, and computer vision, with a capstone model or application built by each participant.

programs.title: Embedded Systems & IoT Track
programs.description: Hands-on work with microcontrollers, sensors, and connected devices - from breadboard prototypes to functioning IoT nodes.

programs.title: Product Design & Prototyping
programs.description: A short programme on turning a rough idea into a testable prototype: problem framing, quick builds, and peer feedback loops.

programs.title: Startup Incubation Programme
programs.description: For teams with a working prototype who want to explore taking it further - light mentorship, pitch practice, and demo day slots.

projects.title: Facial Recognition Attendance System
projects.description: An attendance system that uses facial recognition to identify students and log attendance automatically.

projects.title: Bear Detection System (YOLO)
projects.description: An object detection system built on YOLO to identify bears in image and video feeds.

projects.title: AI-Driven Portable Water Quality Detector
projects.description: A portable device that classifies water quality into Safe, Caution, and Unsafe categories using an AI classification model.

projects.title: ParaVision
projects.member: Olorunfemi Grace Temitayo, Ruqayya Labbo, and Khadija Khalid
projects.description: A computer vision system that tests for malaria from a blood sample in under 5 minutes.
projects.achievement: Winner, Huawei ICT Global Competition - Innovation Track, 2026

events.title: C2P Hackathon 2026
events.description: A 48-hour build sprint open to all Computer Engineering students, ending with a live demo to hub mentors and department staff.

events.title: COEN 554 Project Exhibition
events.description: Final-year students showcased no-JavaScript, JSON-driven websites built for the COEN 554 course, including this hub site.

events.title: Embedded Vision & IoT Workshop
events.description: A hands-on workshop covering ESP32-CAM, computer vision pipelines, and low-cost embedded sensing.

events.title: Hub Induction & Orientation
events.description: Orientation session introducing new members to the hub's tracks, mentors, and facilities.

join.eligibility: Open to all registered Computer Engineering students at ABU Zaria, any level.

steps.title: Pick a Track
steps.description: Choose the track that fits you: AI & Data Science, Embedded Systems & IoT, or Product Design & Prototyping.

steps.title: Submit the Interest Form
steps.description: Fill out the short interest form with your name, level, and the track you'd like to join.

steps.title: Attend Induction
steps.description: Join the next induction session to meet mentors and other members.

steps.title: Start Building
steps.description: Get matched with a project group or start your own, with hub mentorship along the way.
